SELECT i.gene, d.druggable, d.evidence_level, d.example_agents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT gene FROM open_agent.p53_interactions WHERE role = 'internal') i LEFT JOIN open_agent.druggability d ON i.gene = d.gene

SELECT gene, protein, druggable, example_agents, evidence_level, note FROM open_agent.druggability WHERE gene IN ('AKT', 'ATM', 'CDC25A', 'CHEK1_2', 'CCNA', 'CCND1', 'CCNE1', 'E2F1', 'E2F3', 'EGFR', 'FGFR3', 'GRB2', 'MDM2', 'PI3K', 'PTEN', 'RAS', 'RB1', 'RBL2', 'SPRY', 'TP53', 'CDKN2A', 'CDKN1A') AND druggable IN ('yes', 'limited', 'clinical', 'preclinical') ORDER BY evidence_level DESC, gene LIMI
